title: A.T.L.A.S and TranscriptionSync: code and evaluation scripts for training-free lip synchronization of native-audio LLMs
description: Source code of the A.T.L.A.S embodied desktop assistant and the TranscriptionSync lip-synchronization pipeline, together with the experiment scripts of the revised evaluation (paper/revision): wall-clock Layer-1 latency, streaming CTC alignment of the Live API transcription, video-measured GRID evaluation including an Audio2Face-3D port, re-trained audio-to-blendshape regressors, SyncNet offset tests and a re-collected Gemini Live evaluation (English and Turkish). No datasets or model weights are included.

creators.name: Arslan, Murat
